# `get_auto_focus_img`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch the cached auto-focus image as a binary transfer.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager handler @0x113980 (64-bit build), GetAFImage @0x268780 |

Params are not consumed. Registered in the imager image table of both builds; the request is JSON but the response is a binary transfer or a textual no-image error, not ordinary command JSON. Reads the auto-focus image cache and sends it as uncompressed raw (dataType 2). READ. Freshness is unresolved.

Side effects: Reads the auto-focus image cache; diagnostic logging makes the strict grade MUTATOR. The full image and compression descendants are not bounded.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_auto_focus_img"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |
